title: Decoding value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet $\text{Fin}(q)$, let $T$ be a table assigning a Boolean function to each vertex, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and choose a default label in $\text{Fin}(q)$. The decoding value is the candidate decoding value for the candidate sets decoded from $T$ at parameter $\varepsilon$, with that default label.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A Boolean-function table indexed by vertices
caveat: The definitions of decoded candidates and candidate decoding value are absent, so their precise meanings cannot be supplied.
